pool.text: The Portuguese reached the Bay of Dakar in this year.
Peaceful contact was finally opened in Dakar by Diogo Gomes.
Navigator Amerigo Vespucci began to construct his hypothesis about America.
The Portuguese began to use Gorée as a base for slave exportation.
A constituent kingdom of the Jolof Empire broke away.
Gorée was captured by the United Netherlands and given its name.
Gorée fell to the English under Admiral Robert Holmes.
France took over the island of Gorée.
The infamous House of Slaves was built at Gorée.
The slave trade was abolished by France in February.
The marabouts of Cayor revolted against the Damel.
Napoleon Bonaparte reinstated the slave trade in May.
Traders established a factory with warehouses in Rufisque.
The slave trade was finally abolished throughout all French territories.
The commune of Gorée Island was merged into Dakar.
The Battle of Dakar ensued off the coast during the Second World War.
French soldiers opened fire on mutinying West African soldiers at Thiaroye camp.
Cheikh Anta Diop University was established in the city.
Dakar became the capital of the independent Republic of Senegal.
Dakar hosted the Summer Youth Olympics as the first African city.
